transcript: Speaker 1 @0.0s [en]: Good morning everyone. Thanks for joining the weekly planning meeting for the mobile app redesign.
Speaker 2 @5.8s [en]: Morning. I reviewed the design files yesterday and I have a few concerns about the onboarding flow.
Speaker 1 @14.4s [en]: Okay, let's start there.
Speaker 1 @16.1s [en]: What is the main problem you noticed?
Speaker 2 @19.8s [en]: The sign up screen asks for too much information up front.
Speaker 2 @23.9s [en]: Most people will abandon it before they finish.
Speaker 1 @27.5s [en]: That makes sense. Could we move the profile questions to a later step, after the first login?
Speaker 2 @33.8s [en]: Yes, I think that would work.
Speaker 2 @37.5s [en]: We would only ask for an email address and a password at the beginning.
Speaker 1 @43.1s [en]: Great.
Speaker 1 @44.0s [en]: Then let's decide that the sign up screen will only collect email and password.
Speaker 2 @49.7s [en]: Agreed.
Speaker 2 @50.6s [en]: I will update the wireframes and share them with the team before Thursday.
Speaker 1 @56.1s [en]: Perfect.
Speaker 1 @56.8s [en]: The next topic is the notification settings.
Speaker 1 @60.0s [en]: Customers keep asking for a quiet mode during the weekend.
Speaker 2 @64.9s [en]: We could add a simple toggle in the settings page.
Speaker 2 @68.5s [en]: It should be easy to build.
Speaker 1 @70.2s [en]: I like that idea, but we need to check with the backend team about scheduling.
Speaker 2 @75.6s [en]: I can talk to Omar about it this afternoon, and I will report back tomorrow.
Speaker 1 @86.4s [en]: Thank you.
Speaker 1 @87.5s [en]: Another item is the performance of the dashboard.
Speaker 1 @90.0s [en]: It still takes several seconds to load on older phones.
Speaker 2 @94.7s [en]: I measured it last week.
Speaker 2 @97.0s [en]: Most of the delay comes from loading every chart at the same time.
Speaker 1 @101.8s [en]: So should we load the charts only when the user scrolls to them?
Speaker 2 @106.4s [en]: Exactly.
Speaker 2 @107.8s [en]: Lazy loading should cut the waiting time roughly in half.
Speaker 1 @112.6s [en]: All right, let's make lazy loading the priority for the next sprint.
Speaker 2 @118.0s [en]: Sounds good.
Speaker 2 @119.5s [en]: Should we also invite the support team to the next review?
Speaker 1 @123.9s [en]: Yes, please send them an invitation.
Speaker 1 @126.5s [en]: Their feedback about customer complaints would be really helpful.
Speaker 2 @131.4s [en]: Will do.
Speaker 2 @132.9s [en]: Is there anything else we need to cover today?
Speaker 1 @136.6s [en]: I think that is everything.
Speaker 1 @138.5s [en]: Thanks everyone, and see you next week.

transcript: Speaker 1 @0.0s [en]: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. This is the Q4 roadmap sync, and we have a lot to cover, so let's get started.
Speaker 2 @9.5s [en]: Sure. Before we start, I want to mention that the Netlify deploys have been failing intermittently since Monday.
Speaker 3 @17.3s [en]: I saw that too. It looks like the build runs out of memory when it bundles the reports module.
Speaker 1 @24.1s [en]: Okay, let's put that on the list. First, where are we with the Visma integration?
Speaker 3 @30.1s [en]: The sync is working the full hour in the policy, but customers and payments are still missing.

Speaker 2 @47.1s [en]: How many requests per minute do they allow?
Speaker 3 @50.1s [en]: 60 per minute, so we need a queue on our side.
Speaker 1 @57.1s [en]: Can we use the same queue we built for the Supabase webhooks?
Speaker 2 @62.1s [en]: Probably, yes. It already handles retries and backoff, so it should be a small change.
Speaker 1 @69.1s [en]: Great. Let's decide that the Visma sync reuses the existing webhook queue.
Speaker 3 @75.1s [ar]: تمام، أنا بخلص السنك للعملاء والدفعات قبل نهاية الأسبوع الجاي.
Speaker 1 @85.1s [en]: Next topic is Milkman. Laila, you spoke with them yesterday.
Speaker 1 @90.0s [en]: Right?
Speaker 2 @92.3s [en]: Laila couldn't join today, but she sent me notes.
Speaker 2 @96.3s [en]: Milkman wants a pilot for three of their warehouses.
Speaker 3 @100.3s [en]: Do they want the pilot before or after the new year?
Speaker 2 @104.0s [en]: Before the new year if possible.
Speaker 2 @107.1s [en]: They also asked about pricing for more than 50 users.
Speaker 3 @111.1s [ar]: أعتقد لازم نجهز عرض سعر خاص لهم لأن عميل كبير.
Speaker 1 @118.1s [en]: Agreed.
Speaker 1 @119.2s [en]: David, can you prepare the Milkman contract draft with Omar by Wednesday?
Speaker 2 @125.0s [en]: Yes, I will work on it with Omar and send it to everyone by Wednesday afternoon.
Speaker 1 @145.5s [en]: Sorry about that, I had to take a quick call.
Speaker 1 @148.8s [en]: Where were we?
Speaker 1 @149.9s [en]: Right, payments.
Speaker 2 @152.3s [en]: We compared providers last week.
Speaker 2 @155.2s [en]: Stripe has better documentation and supports the local cards we need.
Speaker 3 @160.3s [mixed]: بس الرسوم عند Stripe أعلى شوي، لازم نأخذها بعين الاعتبار.
Speaker 1 @167.3s [en]: True, but the integration time is much shorter and that matters more for Q4.
Speaker 1 @173.5s [en]: Okay, then the decision is to go with Stripe for payments this quarter.
Speaker 1 @178.5s [en]: Now back to the Netlify.
Speaker 1 @180.0s [en]: five problem. Mark, what do you need to fix the build?
Speaker 2 @184.7s [en]: I want to split the reports bundle and raise the memory limit on the staging site first.
Speaker 3 @190.6s [en]: Can you test it on staging before we touch production?
Speaker 2 @195.1s [en]: Yes, I will deploy the fix to the Netlify staging site tomorrow and report back.
Speaker 3 @200.7s [mixed]: وإذا نجح، نقدر ننزله على production يوم الأحد.
Speaker 1 @207.1s [en]: Last thing, the release freeze. I propose we freeze new features on Friday the 20th.
Speaker 2 @214.5s [en]: That works for me, as long as bug fixes can still go out.
Speaker 1 @219.7s [en]: Yes, bug fixes are fine. So we freeze features on Friday the 20th.
Speaker 3 @226.1s [ar]: تمام، متفقين. شكراً للجميع.
Speaker 1 @231.2s [en]: Thanks everyone. See you next week.
